steps.code: <?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; wp_set_current_user(1); $id=wp_insert_post(array('post_type'=>'page','post_status'=>'publish','post_title'=>'v2','post_name'=>'v2','post_content'=>'ORIGINAL_CONTENT_PRESERVED')); $input=array('page_id'=>$id,'opening'=>'Titolo di prova','cta_url'=>'javascript:alert(1)'); $clean=STH_Home_Story::sanitize($input); if($clean['opening']!=='Titolo di prova'||$clean['cta_url']!=='') throw new Exception('Sanitization failed'); update_option(STH_Home_Story::OPTION,$clean); if(STH_Home_Story::options()['opening']!=='Titolo di prova') throw new Exception('Save failed'); wp_set_current_user(0); if(STH_Home_Story::sanitize(array('opening'=>'UNAUTHORIZED'))!==$clean) throw new Exception('Permission failed'); wp_set_current_user(1); update_option(STH_Home_Story::OPTION,array('page_id'=>$id)); if(get_post($id)->post_content!=='ORIGINAL_CONTENT_PRESERVED') throw new Exception('Original page changed'); $html=STH_Home_Story::render(); if(strpos($html,'{{')!==false||strpos($html,'sth-story')===false) throw new Exception('Render failed'); file_put_contents('/qa/wordpress.json',json_encode(array('wordpress'=>get_bloginfo('version'),'php'=>PHP_VERSION,'page_id'=>$id,'activation'=>true,'save_read'=>true,'permission_rejection'=>true,'original_preserved'=>true,'render'=>true),JSON_PRETTY_PRINT));
